text: {"question": "How did the mean monthly migraine frequency change after the third session of peripheral nerve blocks in adolescents with medically refractory migraine?", "answer": "Following the third session of peripheral nerve blocks, the mean monthly migraine frequency decreased significantly from 14.4 days to 4.7 days.", "evidence": "The results revealed that the mean monthly migraine frequency decreased from 14.4 to 4.7 days after the third session and the mean VAS score decreased from 7.7 to 3.3."}
